lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Look at them. Little dumb machines walking circles on a lawn. Not one of them knows what it's for, and neither does she, and she's the cleverest person in the building.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Burn it now and nothing after it happens. None of it. Not the Handover, not the Quiet, not my camp. I'm not proposing it. I'm saying it out loud so you know I thought it, because I'd rather you heard it from me than worked it out later.
